F1: The matcher checks the wrong prefix characters and rejects matching grants, so it can accept the wrong grant or throw on short prefixes.
F2: The test catches the `NullPointerException` from the uninitialized session factory, so it passes without verifying the intended invalid-grant rejection.
F3: Registration and dynamic lookup accept shortcuts longer than two characters, producing token IDs the fixed-width decoder rejects.
F4: The constructor checks `grantType` twice and permits a null `rawTokenId`, which can be encoded as `null`.
